neighbours.label: the token ' Wii' (Nintendo's console); other consoles in the same sentence stay low
fire: My grandparents surprised everyone by bowling on the Wii every Sunday.
The store sold out of the Wii within hours of the launch.
For physical therapy, the clinic used a Wii and its balance board.
We dusted off our old Wii and played tennis all evening.
Reviewers praised the Wii for its simple motion controls.
He kept the Wii in the basement next to the old sofa.
Sales of the Wii U were much lower than the company hoped.
Our neighbours lent us their Wii for the kids' birthday party.
quiet: My grandparents surprised everyone by bowling on the PlayStation every Sunday.
The store sold out of the Xbox within hours of the launch.
For physical therapy, the clinic used a tablet and its balance app.
We dusted off our old PlayStation and played tennis all evening.
Reviewers praised the Xbox for its simple controller layout.
He kept the television in the basement next to the old sofa.
Sales of the Xbox One were much lower than the company hoped.
Our neighbours lent us their projector for the kids' birthday party.
